note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The routing tag carries the supplied return point (beforeValue); the substitution replaces it with the alternative supplied value (afterValue) and only the dependent geometry follows: the doors of the old point close, those of afterIndex open and the folder runs to that tray (a ghost outline keeps the old place). No validity, rule or result of any examination is inferred; the renewed examination is not shown. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, focusTarget, beforeValue, afterValue, detailGeometry and contextLabels are editable.
